title: Radar Chart
styles:
.demo--chart { height: 22rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .demo--chart-sm { height: 18rem; }

blocks.html: Compara varias variables a la vez sobre una rejilla radial. Ideal para perfiles (habilidades, atributos de producto, métricas de rendimiento).

<is-radar-chart open-on-click label="Employee Skills">
            <script type="application/json">
              {
                "data": {
                  "labels": ["Communication", "Technical", "Leadership", "Creativity", "Teamwork", "Problem Solving"],
                  "datasets": [
                    {
                      "label": "Alice",
                      "data": [85, 92, 70, 88, 95, 78],
                      "fill": true,
                      "backgroundColor": "color-mix(in srgb, crimson 38%, transparent)",
                      "borderColor": "crimson"
                    },
                    {
                      "label": "Bob",
                      "data": [72, 78, 90, 65, 80, 88],
                      "fill": true,
                      "backgroundColor": "color-mix(in srgb, #339af0 38%, transparent)",
                      "borderColor": "#339af0"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              }
            </script>
          </is-radar-chart>

sections.title: Datos con JSON
sections.lede: Coloca un <script type="application/json"> hijo. Cada valor de data mapea a una etiqueta del eje radial (formato Chart.js).

blocks.html:
<is-radar-chart open-on-click label="Feature Comparison">
            <script type="application/json">
              {
                "data": {
                  "labels": ["Speed", "Reliability", "Ease of Use", "Features", "Support"],
                  "datasets": [{ "label": "Product A", "data": [85, 90, 75, 80, 70], "fill": true }]
                }
              }
            </script>
          </is-radar-chart>

blocks.code:
<is-radar-chart label="Feature Comparison">
  <script type="application/json">
    {
      "data": {
        "labels": ["Speed", "Reliability", "Ease of Use", "Features", "Support"],
        "datasets": [{ "label": "Product A", "data": [85, 90, 75, 80, 70], "fill": true }]
      }
    }
  </script>
</is-radar-chart>

sections.title: Datos con JavaScript
sections.lede: Asigna config; el chart se re-renderiza solo.

blocks.html:
<is-radar-chart open-on-click label="Clases" legend-position="end">
            <script type="application/json">
              {
                "data": {
                  "labels": ["Strength", "Agility", "Intelligence", "Wisdom", "Charisma"],
                  "datasets": [
                    { "label": "Warrior", "data": [95, 70, 50, 60, 65], "fill": true },
                    { "label": "Mage", "data": [40, 55, 95, 90, 70], "fill": true }
                  ]
                }
              }
            </script>
          </is-radar-chart>
